segments.name: Specialty Finance
segments.description: Provides funding and customized financial products to incorporated nonprofit community associations, mainly in Florida.
segments.evidence: With respect to our specialty finance business, the Company has historically engaged in the business of providing funding to nonprofit community associations primarily located in the state of Florida.

segments.name: Mining and Treasury Operations
segments.description: Mines Bitcoin with its own computing power and holds Bitcoin as a long-term treasury investment.
segments.evidence: We conduct this business through a wholly owned subsidiary, US Digital, which we formed in 2021 to develop and operate our Bitcoin mining business.

revenueModel.text: Florida nonprofit community associations receive funding and financial products from the company; mining earns Bitcoin for validating transactions on the network.
